evals.name: Mobile-first layout
evals.prompt: Build a 3-column card grid that stacks on mobile
assertions: Cards stack to single column on small screens

evals.name: Fluid typography
evals.prompt: Make the heading scale smoothly from mobile to desktop
assertions: No fixed pixel values for responsive text

evals.name: Container queries
evals.prompt: Build a card component that adapts its layout based on its container width

evals.name: Touch targets
evals.prompt: Make all interactive elements touch-friendly on mobile

evals.name: Responsive navigation
evals.prompt: Build a navigation that becomes a hamburger menu on mobile

evals.name: Responsive images
evals.prompt: Serve different image sizes for mobile and desktop

evals.name: Anti-pattern detection
assertions: Identifies max-width media query as desktop-first
